miscUi5.permissionNotActivated: Permission could not be activated after requesting it. Toggle screenpipe on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Input Monitoring. If the toggle is already on but capture still fails, click Reset & try again to clear a stale TCC record and re-request.
miscUi5.restartInputHint: Restart screenpipe to start capturing keystrokes and clicks. The running recorder was started without Input Monitoring and won't pick up the change until next launch.
